title: Upper Strength
description: Two classic upper body blocks: chest-triceps push and complete back-shoulder pull

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Plank to downward dog
exercises.instructions: Alternate between high plank and downward dog position

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.instructions: In a plank, squeeze and spread shoulder blades without bending elbows

exercises.name: Explosive push-ups
exercises.instructions: Push hard to lift hands off the floor

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated surface, easier variation

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Prone T raises
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms in a T shape, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Floor face pulls
exercises.instructions: Face down, elbows at 90 degrees, pull backward

exercises.name: Reverse snow angels
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms along the body, arc on the floor

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
